illustration.src: Generic cutaway of a multicore with coax cores: jacket cut back, shields and dielectric stepped down to the centre conductors, plain cores alongside. Illustrative, not to scale. Drawn for WireHub from public dimensions; CC0-1.0, not traced from any vendor drawing.
